description: Defines the GotoAction class for redirecting to a specified URL within Drupal, implementing configuration, execution, and access control.

classes.name: GotoAction
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that performs URL redirection, configurable via form, with access control and event dispatching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the GotoAction with dispatcher and URL assembler services.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the URL redirection, handling internal and external URLs, and sets up event response.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration with an empty URL.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds a form for setting the redirect URL.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves the URL configuration from form input.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Determines if the action is allowed based on access result.
